blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of front, back, side and three-quarter views shows asymmetric overskirt drape: one side lifts while the other collapses into angular folds. Both side profiles show doubled and stacked lilac hem segments. The trim does not yet read as one continuous edge around both hips.

Irregular gray patches remain visible through the white chest and waist in neutral, arms-up and arm-cross renders. The source is unresolved; the images do not distinguish clearance/intersection from exposed source surface or shading.

In crouch and sit, both shorts-clad thighs project through the front of the overskirt while its center panel hangs behind them. The lower skirt silhouette and thigh clearance remain unacceptable in bent-leg poses.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
